canon_source: §102 Updated Completion Ledger Fields (+ §99 mandatory ablations)
purpose: Prevents "brain-inspired" from becoming an untestable label: every ledger row states its neuro claim, its limit and the §99 ablation that tests it.

classes.ENGINEERING_ONLY: Learning/engineering component; brain vocabulary not claimed.
classes.FUNCTIONAL_ANALOGY: Claims a function analogous to a brain function.

MODULE_NEUROMOD.neuro_claim_limit: Three-factor rule e×δ×M×P as engineering credit assignment for external shadow heads; no claim about dopamine/acetylcholine physiology; evidence is a synthetic open-loop stream with linear NLMS learners, no language model.

ablation_baseline.hypothesis: §99 Eligibility helps + Typed modulators help + Metaplasticity (META rule) helps
ablation_baseline.note: Eligibility beats gradient-only/random mask 5/5 but not recency-only (1/5); the slow trace adds nothing measurable; typed modulators beat scalar reward and human-only 5/5; the gate alone does not stop dream/self labels (data-mix quotas needed); per-sample δ beats every control 5/5 on the delayed stream. META rule (2026-10-12, preregistered): beats only fixed permissive P (5/5); fixed conservative and budget-matched P are better (1/5), the novelty and repeated-failure terms add nothing.

F7_MEASURED_PLASTICITY.neuro_claim_limit: Metaplasticity = measured per-component shadow-budget feedback; no learned neural controller, no native shared-layer measurement.

MODULE_HOMEOSTASIS.neuro_claim_limit: Synaptic-scaling analogy only: per-path activation/update frequency normalised between Sleep C runs; acts only after explicit human activation.

ablation_baseline.note: Preregistered, 5 seeds: beats every control on the primary metric (5/5, reopen 4/5), but margins are small (.181 vs .187 none); the gain comes from update-budget damping and dead-path reopen, dominant-path inhibition adds ~0. Synthetic only; regulation is ACTIVE only after explicit human activation.

MODULE_AGE.neuro_claim_limit: Critical-period analogy as an explicit capability/plasticity envelope under human control; synthetic stream only; shipped ceiling is Age 0.

ablation_baseline.note: BOOT policy is worse than fixed conservative in the noisy phase (0/5); only the opt-in noise_aware policy reaches the best noisy/final error, at a slower shift (needs user approval).

MODULE_FASTFORWARD.neuro_claim_limit: Habit/proceduralisation analogy: OBSERVE→SHADOW→READY lifecycle with reopen on error; synthetic stream only, no real-model skill transfer shown.

ablation_baseline.note: 52 % lower cost than full deliberation with fewer errors; static shortcut fails on drift and salient turns.

F9_EPISODIC_REPLAY.neuro_claim_limit: Hippocampal-replay analogy: explicit bounded episodic re-evaluation; generates no fact or weight authority.

ablation_baseline.note: Dream2 (40 B-steps, seeds 13/21/34): validated dreams raise A-paraphrase .42→.75 but drop probe retention .61→.19; unanchored dreams also harm probes.

MODULE_SLEEP.neuro_claim_limit: Sleep A/B/C phases as scheduler states; replay items carry no learning authority; no claim about biological sleep stages.

ablation_baseline.note: Same cohort as F9_EPISODIC_REPLAY: dreams help paraphrase, hurt probe retention.

MODULE_SLEEP_OFFLINE.neuro_claim_limit: Offline compute during sleep; candidates only, no autonomous consolidation.

STEP3_FAST_EPISODIC.neuro_claim_limit: Complementary-learning-systems analogy (fast episodic vs slow parametric); 230M master, 8 facts, one seed, lexical retrieval.

ablation_baseline.note: Both real mechanisms beat the answer cache on paraphrases (.33/.50 vs 0); retrieval leaks on near-miss questions (.4); one seed.

MODULE_EPISODIC_ROUTE.neuro_claim_limit: Second-attempt-better for routes from human corrections; shadow by default.

MODULE_EPISODES.neuro_claim_limit: Event segmentation analogy (noisy-OR of boundary cues with §51.2 BOOT weights); no learned boundary policy.

ablation_baseline.hypothesis: §99-style: event segmentation cuts at real topic boundaries
ablation_baseline.note: Preregistered, 5 seeds × 40 texts: beats fixed chunks 5/5 and random sentence cuts 4/5, but not evenly spaced sentence cuts of the same count (2/5 flat, 0/5 with paragraph cue). The length prior plus sentence end already reach the threshold, so cuts follow length, not topic.

STEP2_SPLIT_BRAIN_OBSERVER.neuro_claim_limit: Two-hemisphere analogy = two complementary dense bodies (detail/gist); temporary dense harness bodies.

ablation_baseline.hypothesis: §99 Fine/Gist split helps + two bodies pay off on mobile
ablation_baseline.note: STEP2 UTILITY_FAIL; frozen 70/70 cohort still fails.

STEP2_BODY_STATE_POLICY.neuro_claim_limit: Integration-timescale analogy per body; see STEP2_SPLIT_BRAIN_OBSERVER.

ablation_baseline.note: STEP2 UTILITY_FAIL.

B3_LATENT.neuro_claim_limit: Corpus-callosum analogy for latent B1↔B2 messages; injection OFF.

ablation_baseline.note: L1 receiver readout and STEP2 ablation fail the utility gate.

MODULE_CALLOSUM.neuro_claim_limit: Callosum controller reports per direction; no latent authority.

ablation_baseline.note: Utility gate G-CALLOSUM-UTILITY not met.

MODULE_B3BRIDGE.neuro_claim_limit: Trained message bridge; never grants latent authority.

ablation_baseline.note: Bridge does not pass the B3-H12 completion gate.

MODULE_FOCAL.neuro_claim_limit: Global-workspace analogy: limited focal slots, coalition and recurrent rounds; utility with real models inside the noise band.

ablation_baseline.note: No arm outside the baseline noise band (pass .42–.58, 12 tasks).

MODULE_WORKSPACE_LEARN.neuro_claim_limit: Workspace hold multiplier learned from refresh utility; SHADOW unless a human activates it.

ablation_baseline.hypothesis: §99-style: learned per-kind hold multiplier reduces restore losses
ablation_baseline.note: Preregistered rule met (4/5, 5/5, 4/5) and the learner finds MEMORY > B1 > B2, but the effect is ~0.4 % fewer restore losses: fresh items enter at decay 1 and the multiplier can only slow decay, so under capacity pressure it barely matters. Harness workspace keeps by decay, not full priority.

MODULE_ATTENTION.neuro_claim_limit: Thalamic gain analogy for admission/action gain; only the learned usefulness prior is ablated (synthetic), gain modulation untested.

ablation_baseline.hypothesis: §99-style: learned §4B.4 usefulness prior improves F1 admission
ablation_baseline.note: Preregistered, 5 seeds, real Attention on SQLite: ACTIVE prior beats SHADOW scaffold 5/5 on blind and informed streams (.16 vs .04; .47 vs .38), far below oracle .60 (LEARNED_MAX cap). Salience/caution gain modulation itself is not tested.

MODULE_SELFMODEL.neuro_claim_limit: Efference-copy/corollary-discharge analogy: SelfCorollary before every dispatch, self/world attribution; no claim of self-awareness.

ablation_baseline.note: Preregistered, 5 seeds: attribution beats every control 5/5 (balanced accuracy .77 vs ≤.57, never false SELF) but labels 54–66 % of external events on an open own channel as MIXED (own failure); attenuation beats none/random 5/5, full subtraction is better in this stream. Safety reads raw values in every arm. Tolerance-ceiling candidate FAIL (2026-10-12): removes the external→MIXED error but loses own failures, partly because attribute measures the residual against the first open own action, not the nearest prediction. Candidate 2 (nearest residual + ceiling K=20) fixes the standard stream (.77→.97, no lost failures) but FAILs the preregistered stress criterion (own failures 20–40× off read as external).

F4_SELF_WORLD_OBSERVATIONS.neuro_claim_limit: Corollary copy is matched to the committed own outcome; digital actions only.

F4_DIGITAL_ACTION_PREDICTOR.neuro_claim_limit: Forward-model analogy for scoped digital actions; broad external-world causal prediction unproven.

ablation_baseline.note: Text actions: not better than mean delta. (Later fixed-mean-delta + ridge rest confirmed on calc/sandbox_note tool worlds on another branch; not this module.)

STEP6_DENSE_LOCAL_PREDICTOR.neuro_claim_limit: Predictive-coding analogy on frozen dense taps with stop-gradient EMA target; no backbone training.

ablation_baseline.note: JEPA .73–.76 AUROC equals no predictor .74.

MODULE_WORLD_MODEL.neuro_claim_limit: World/goal model bookkeeping; no learned causal model claim.

STEP5_EXTERNAL_ROUTE_LEARNING.neuro_claim_limit: External route classifier; no neuro claim.

F3_LEARNED_CUE_RETRIEVAL.neuro_claim_limit: Source-pair relevance head; no neuro claim.

C3_NATIVE_OUTPUT_DELTA.neuro_claim_limit: Output vocabulary row delta; no neuro claim.

MODULE_SPARSE_MEMORY.neuro_claim_limit: Gated memory slots as fast parametric store; one seed, 8 facts, 230M dense master.

ablation_baseline.note: Only gated slots forget nothing (KL≈0) but generalise worse (paraphrase .50).

MODULE_GIST.neuro_claim_limit: Coarse integration timescale (gist slots); structural readout only in this tree.

ablation_baseline.note: Structural metrics only here; real-B2 utility run (other branch) recorded GIST_NO_GAIN.

MODULE_ANCHOR.neuro_claim_limit: Representation anchor regulariser; no neuro claim.

MODULE_REFLEX.neuro_claim_limit: Reflex fast path analogy; deterministic rules.

MODULE_LATEWATCH.neuro_claim_limit: Late salient interrupt analogy; shadow by default.

MODULE_APLANE.neuro_claim_limit: Perception plane teacher/student analogy; text only at Age 0.

MODULE_VISION.neuro_claim_limit: Vision lab scaffold; not in the live path.
